text.jp:
……あ、あの、
実はあなたにお願いしたいことがあるのですが……
text.official_en:
Oh... Excuse me. If you have time, there's something
I've been meaning to ask you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ

text.jp:
私をお側に置いてもらえませんでしょうか……
以前、商会の倉庫整理の際に大失態を晒したのです。
text.official_en:
Would you consider having me by your side? I made
an error while cleaning the company storehouse.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ

text.jp:
汚れが酷いからと高価な壺を捨てたのです。
私は無知でした。故に見聞を広めたいのです……！
text.official_en:
I threw away a priceless urn, thinking it was garbage.
I was so careless... I need to learn to be...better.

あ、ありがとうございます……
text.official_en: Really?! Th-thank you so much...

of wound or ailment.

ですがもし、癒やし手が必要になればいつでも……

Of course... My apologies. If you are ever in need of a
healer, please come find me...

……ひょっとして……
今、私は勧誘されているのでしょうか？
text.official_en:
Oh, it's you! You weren't trying to get my attention
were you?

text.jp:
タリムーンさんのお側を離れることなど
想像もできません。どうぞお引き取りを。
text.official_en:
I would not even entertain leaving Talimun's side.
Please...be on your way.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ

え……？　私を勧誘されているのですか？　
せっかくですが、他所をおあたりください……
text.official_en:
Hm? Did you want to ask me something? Thank you
for your interest, but please, try elsewhere...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ

text.jp:
……私は、タリムーンさんの側に居たいのです。
その為には、まだまだ力が足りなくて……
text.official_en:
I want to remain by Talimun's side but don't have
the strength to do so...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ

text.jp:
実は、過去の記憶がなくて……それもあって
人一倍、努力をしなければならないのです。
text.official_en:
The truth is I have no memory of my past. Knowing
that, I must work harder than most.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_フィアナ

それならば、あなたのお誘いに乗ります……
text.official_en:
I know! Perhaps you could train me in secret?
If so, then I accept your invitation.

text.official_en:
I'll tell Talimun that this is work-related. Could you
offer compensation in case he gets curious?
